name: Duel Ladder
notes: Destroy the town center and every production building of the bot. Only the end class destroyed (also stranded) is a win; decay, mutual destruction, time limit and cutoff are never a win. Sudden death, wonder and shrines are off; the cutoff (maxGameSeconds) ends the game before the sim time limit, so no score or seed winner is crowned. levels is the range of the ladder: level 0 is the idle bot, level 3 is the current bot; levels 1 and 2 are built in track 2. Board seeds: a level 1-3 cell is 8 games (4 bot styles x 2 seats), game i uses board[i]; a level 0 cell is 4 games (2 seats x board[0..1]). Tune seeds are for calibration and the pilot. The board list is frozen in SEEDS-HASH.txt.
